elements.label: Insight document thumbnail: grey hover overlay fades in then back out as the cursor passes

elements.manual_reason: The mouse cursor has no candidate box; it travels from the thumbnail down to the second insight's feature link.
elements.label: Mouse cursor

pattern.description: Screen recording: the cursor sweeps over an attached document thumbnail, which darkens under a grey hover overlay and returns to normal as the cursor moves on.
pattern.why_premium: A brief hover state lands on 'existing insights', quietly pointing at the attached evidence without an added callout or zoom.

build_hint.gsap: Overlay div on the thumbnail: gsap.timeline().to(overlay, {autoAlpha:0.35, duration:0.1, ease:'power1.out'}).to(overlay, {autoAlpha:0, duration:0.2, ease:'power1.in'}, '+=0.05'); cursor gsap.to(x/y path toward the next insight, 0.3s, power2.inOut) in parallel.
build_hint.remotion: Overlay opacity = interpolate(frame, [0,3,5,11], [0,0.35,0.35,0], {extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); cursor position interpolated with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad) over ~9 frames.

notes: Only one (union) candidate box; it also spans the static header and link text, but the change is the thumbnail's hover overlay. Incidental UI hover from a live recording rather than authored motion; cursor uses a manual box.
